Learn German · A1

German at A1: Beginner

You understand and use everyday expressions and very simple sentences: introduce yourself, ask where someone lives and what they do, order in a café, buy a ticket, fill in a form - if the other person speaks slowly and is willing to help.

How long: about 80-200 lessons of 45 minutes (Goethe-Institut guidance). The course below is 10 weeks at this level; a week is about an hour a day.

The 10 weeks

  1. Week 1: Hello! My name is … Hallo! Ich heiße …

    Greet people and say goodbye, introduce yourself, say where you are from and which languages you speak, and ask others the same.

    Grammar sein, haben and the present-tense endings · W-questions and yes/no questions
    Words and reading greetings and introductions
    Drills numbers
    Speaking meeting a new colleague on your first day and introducing yourself
    Ask the tutor
    • How do I introduce myself in German, formally and informally? Wie stelle ich mich auf Deutsch vor, formell und informell?
    • How do I spell my name in German? Please go through the alphabet with me. Wie buchstabiere ich meinen Namen auf Deutsch? Geh bitte das Alphabet mit mir durch.

  2. Week 2: My family and me Meine Familie und ich

    Talk about your family and friends, say how old people are and what they do, and ask about someone's family.

    Grammar Possessive articles: mein, dein, sein, ihr … · Main clauses: the verb takes position 2
    Words and reading the family, work
    Drills articles
    Speaking showing a friend photos of your family
    Ask the tutor
    • How do I talk about my family: names, ages and jobs? Wie spreche ich über meine Familie: Namen, Alter und Berufe?

  3. Week 3: Enjoy your meal! Guten Appetit!

    Order food and drink in a café or restaurant, say what you like, ask what something costs and pay.

    Grammar der, die, das: nominative and accusative
    Words and reading food and drink
    Drills prices
    Speaking ordering at a café · reserving a table at a restaurant

  4. Week 4: Shopping Einkaufen

    Buy food and clothes, ask for sizes, colours and quantities, understand prices and say what you do not need.

    Grammar Plural forms: -e, -(e)n, -er, -s or nothing · kein or nicht?
    Words and reading clothes
    Drills plurals
    Speaking buying rolls at the bakery · paying at the supermarket checkout
    Ask the tutor
    • How do I use welcher, welche, welches and dieser, diese, dieses when I shop? Wie benutze ich welcher, welche, welches und dieser, diese, dieses beim Einkaufen?

  5. Week 5: My day Mein Tag

    Tell the time, describe your daily routine and your week, and make or change appointments.

    Grammar Separable verbs · Vowel change in the present tense: er wirft, er sieht, er fährt
    Words and reading the daily routine
    Drills the clock
    Speaking apologising to a friend for being late
    Ask the tutor
    • How do I describe my daily routine, from getting up to going to bed? Wie beschreibe ich meinen Tagesablauf, vom Aufstehen bis zum Schlafengehen?

  6. Week 6: At home Wohnen

    Describe your flat and your furniture, say where things are and what you like about where you live, and understand a flat advertisement.

    Grammar Time and place phrases: um, am, im, von … bis; in, nach, zu, bei
    Words and reading the flat
    Drills meanings
    Speaking asking a landlord questions about a flat you want to rent
    Ask the tutor
    • How do I describe my flat and where the furniture is? Wie beschreibe ich meine Wohnung und wo die Möbel stehen?

  7. Week 7: Out and about in town In der Stadt unterwegs

    Ask for and give directions, use buses, trains and taxis, and name the places in a town.

    Grammar The imperative: du, ihr, Sie
    Words and reading the city
    Drills meanings
    Speaking asking the way to the town hall · taking a taxi

  8. Week 8: Free time and meeting up Freizeit und Verabredungen

    Talk about your hobbies, say what you can and want to do, invite someone and agree on a day and a time.

    Grammar Modal verbs
    Words and reading hobbies and sport
    Drills dates
    Speaking buying cinema tickets
    Ask the tutor
    • How do I invite a friend and suggest a time and a place? Wie lade ich einen Freund ein und schlage Zeit und Ort vor?

  9. Week 9: Health Gesundheit

    Name the parts of the body, say what hurts, make a doctor's appointment and understand simple advice.

    Grammar Telling the gender from the noun ending
    Words and reading the body and health
    Drills articles
    Speaking booking a doctor's appointment by phone · buying something for a cough at the pharmacy · making an appointment at the doctor's reception
    Ask the tutor
    • How do I say ‘I was’ and ‘I had’ in German, for example when I was ill: war and hatte? Wie sage ich „ich war“ und „ich hatte“ auf Deutsch, zum Beispiel wenn ich krank war: war und hatte?

  10. Week 10: Travel and weather Reisen und Wetter

    Buy a ticket, check in at a hotel, talk about the weather and say what you did on a trip, in the Perfekt.

    Grammar Perfekt with haben or sein?
    Words and reading transport and travel, the weather
    Drills verbs
    Speaking buying a train ticket at the station · checking in at a hotel

Grammar at A1

  • Vowel change in the present tense: er wirft, er sieht, er fährt Vokalwechsel im Präsens: er wirft, er sieht, er fährt
  • kein or nicht? kein oder nicht?
  • Modal verbs Modalverben
  • The imperative: du, ihr, Sie Imperativ: du, ihr, Sie
  • Main clauses: the verb takes position 2 Hauptsatz: das Verb steht auf Position 2
  • sein, haben and the present-tense endings sein, haben und die Präsens-Endungen
  • W-questions and yes/no questions W-Fragen und Ja/Nein-Fragen
  • der, die, das: nominative and accusative der, die, das: Nominativ und Akkusativ
  • Possessive articles: mein, dein, sein, ihr … Possessivartikel: mein, dein, sein, ihr …
  • Plural forms: -e, -(e)n, -er, -s or nothing Pluralformen: -e, -(e)n, -er, -s oder nichts
  • Time and place phrases: um, am, im, von … bis; in, nach, zu, bei Zeit- und Ortsangaben: um, am, im, von … bis; in, nach, zu, bei

Conversations at A1

  • Buying rolls at the bakery Brötchen kaufen in der Bäckerei
  • Ordering at a café Etwas bestellen im Café
  • Booking a doctor's appointment by phone Einen Arzttermin am Telefon vereinbaren
  • Buying a train ticket at the station Eine Fahrkarte am Bahnhof kaufen
  • Paying at the supermarket checkout An der Supermarktkasse bezahlen
  • Checking in at a hotel Im Hotel einchecken
  • Buying something for a cough at the pharmacy In der Apotheke etwas gegen Husten kaufen
  • Reserving a table at a restaurant Einen Tisch im Restaurant reservieren
  • Asking the way to the town hall Nach dem Weg zum Rathaus fragen
  • Apologising to a friend for being late Sich bei einer Freundin für die Verspätung entschuldigen
  • Taking a taxi Mit dem Taxi fahren
  • Buying cinema tickets Kinokarten kaufen
  • Making an appointment at the doctor's reception Einen Termin in der Arztpraxis vereinbaren

Exams at A1

Goethe-Zertifikat A1: Start Deutsch 1, telc Deutsch A1 and ÖSD Zertifikat A1 are the exams at this level; the A1 certificate is what the German family-reunification visa asks for.
